description: A precise include list and an empty exclude list. Exclude takes precedence over include in Pages, so any broad exclude here could stop a blocked path reaching the middleware, which is exactly how the competency library stayed readable on the Calibrate origin after that origin had been fixed. Only the paths listed here invoke a Worker; every other request is served straight from static assets with no Worker cost. THE LIST IS ALSO WHAT DECIDES WHETHER THE MIDDLEWARE RUNS AT ALL: three live maintenance rehearsals on 14 August 2026 failed on shop-web because the block was written into _middleware.js and this file never routed a page request to it, so a correct middleware ran zero times for "/". The document paths after the deny list are what make maintenance mode reachable. Assets are deliberately still absent: only documents need to become a maintenance page, and routing every image and font through a Function is a real cost for no benefit.
